subject.title: Google Chat: markdown renders as raw text; typing indicator says 'OpenClaw is typing' instead of app name

question: Should Google Chat convert assistant Markdown into Google Chat-supported markup, strip unsupported Markdown to plain text, or keep the current Markdown-capable contract and narrow this issue to the typing-name bug?
rationale: Current source marks Google Chat as Markdown-capable, the report asks for strip or conversion behavior, and related discussion challenged the premise that Google Chat cannot render Markdown; automation should not choose the permanent channel rendering contract.

options.title: Convert Supported Markup
options.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat syntax, strips unsupported markers, and fixes the typing fallback in the same owner-local path.

options.title: Plain Text Only
options.body: Treat Google Chat as plain text by stripping Markdown and updating metadata, docs, and tests to remove the current Markdown-capable contract.

options.title: Typing Fix Only
options.body: Fix `agent.identity.name` in the typing fallback and explicitly document that Google Chat remains Markdown-capable without a bespoke dialect converter.

recommendation.title: Convert Supported Markup
recommendation.body: Add a Google Chat renderer that maps common assistant Markdown into Google Chat syntax, strips unsupported markers, and fixes the typing fallback in the same owner-local path.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision is reply-formatting product direction, and steipete has the strongest recent history on the shared reply-delivery path.
